summary: One record per medication (or constant-dosing interval) per subject. Code with WHODrug, and keep the verbatim name in CMTRT.

CMTRT.tip: The medication name exactly as collected.

CMDECOD.tip: WHODrug preferred name from your coding output.

CMCAT.tip: E.g. "PRIOR" / "CONCOMITANT" if your CRF separates them, or the CRF page.

CMSTRF.tip: Start relative to the study reference period, e.g. "BEFORE" for prior medications with no start date.

CMENRTPT.tip: "ONGOING" with CMENTPT for medications still taken at the reference time point.
